name: Chai Watana Tannery Group Public Company Limited
summary: Chai Watana Tannery Group Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and exports leather finished products. It operates through six segments: Tannery Hide, Automotive Leather Cutting, Dog Chewable Toys, Furniture, Energy Business, and Design and Distribution of Aluminum Boat and Mini Bus. The company offers trim seat covers, steering wheels and gear knobs, and dog chews, as well as cutting, spray, and beam house and tanning services. In addition, it is involved in the design and distribution of boats and minibuses; rental of properties; provision of consulting services for renewable energy projects; waste management business; wholesale of wood chips; and generation and sale of electricity using waste fuels. Chai Watana Tannery Group Public Company Limited was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Mueang Samut Prakan, Thailand.
